coverage_scope: Finite union of inspected schemas, documented examples and catalog metadata; not a guarantee of provider-populated fields or all possible LinkedIn data.

shared.name: key
shared.note: Required stable internal identity. Never a person's name or a company-name slug.

shared.name: created_at
shared.note: Required UTC time when we first created this record.

shared.name: updated_at
shared.note: Required UTC time of the latest local record change.

shared.name: enriched_at
shared.note: Time of the last accepted successful profile lookup. Failed attempts do not advance it.

shared.name: last_attempt_at
shared.note: Time of the latest attempted lookup.

shared.name: enrichment_status
shared.note: Pending, enriched, partial, no_match, ambiguous, failed, or budget_deferred. Freshness is evaluated separately.

shared.name: error
shared.note: Latest safe, human-readable error; no credentials or headers.

shared.name: cost_usd
shared.note: Cost attributed to the latest attempt, nullable when unknown. Aggregate spend comes from run accounting, not a sum of these mutable rows.

shared.name: identifiers_json
shared.note: Stored in the table gtm.profile_identifiers (entity, namespace, value, key, observed_at), not as a column: one owner per identifier. Keep numeric and opaque LinkedIn identifiers distinct.

shared.name: sources_json
shared.note: Source/import/workflow membership, original row key, network owner/kind when supplied, connection date, first and last observation.

shared.name: provenance_json
shared.note: For each field or section: provider, endpoint, response reference/path, fetched time, provider-updated time if returned, and reported/inferred classification when known.

shared.name: section_status_json
shared.note: Per section: complete, partial, unsupported, not_requested, unknown, or failed, with returned count and provider total/cursor when available.

shared.name: raw_responses_json
shared.note: Latest retained response envelope per provider/endpoint/mode, plus the response supporting current values if a later attempt failed or was ambiguous. Includes unmapped fields. No unbounded history or secrets.

mapping_rules: Mappings name the storage destination, not a literal copy operation or a tested adapter.
All original source values remain in raw_responses_json, including alternate values mapped to one canonical field.
Structured sections preserve all nested provider fields in raw responses; canonical nested names are described in the Markdown proposal.
Recommendations carry received/given/unknown direction; ambiguous direction stays unknown.
Company range endpoints additionally populate employee_count_min/max; the label is a read projection.
Parsed locations additionally populate scalar location columns only when semantics are established.
Profile image objects additionally populate preferred image URL columns.
Primary locale retains its native object in raw responses while its canonical text requires enough components.
Company country is a headquarters country only when the endpoint establishes that meaning; otherwise retain only source evidence.
Reported employee count remains separate from explicit LinkedIn employee count. Harvest employeeCount semantics need adapter validation.
No provider-defined update time is copied over our local updated_at.
known_documentation_gaps: HarvestAPI Profile.companyWebsites refers to undefined CompanyWebsite schema.
HarvestAPI recommendations are opaque objects; complete nested shape is not specified.
Bright Data null examples do not establish nested shapes for alumni, stock or absent sections.
Monid Clay person summary is descriptive, not a machine-readable output contract.
No paid profile lookup was executed to verify documented fields.
